title: Looks Can be Deceiving: Annotator and Reviewer Performance Across Imagery Sources in Crowd-Sourced Aerial Damage Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.14942v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents the first known empirical investigation of annotator and reviewer performance across multi-source remotely sensed imagery, evaluating human labeling across drone, crewed aviation, and satellite views. Because existing aerial imagery datasets rely predominantly on single-source imagery, there is no currently established state of practice for efficiently allocating human labor to curate large-scale, multi-source aerial datasets. This work addresses this limitation by analyzing annotator and reviewer performance within a post-disaster building damage assessment dataset of 9 disasters, where 20041 buildings in drone, 20695 buildings in crewed aviation, and 33392 buildings in satellite imagery were labeled. translated_title: 表象可能具有欺骗性：众包空中灾害评估中不同影像来源下的标注者与审查者表现
translated_abstract: 本文首次对多源遥感影像下的标注者与审查者表现进行了实证研究，评估了无人机、有人驾驶航空和卫星视角下的人工标注情况。由于现有的空中影像数据集主要依赖单一来源的影像，目前尚无既定的实践标准来高效分配人力资源以整理大规模、多来源的空中数据集。本研究通过分析一个包含9场灾害的灾后建筑损害评估数据集来弥补这一不足，其中无人机影像中标注了20041栋建筑，有人驾驶航空影像中标注了20695栋建筑，卫星影像中标注了33392栋建筑。这些由187名标注者提供的标签，随后通过两个连续的质量控制阶段进行细化：单审查者审查和共识委员会审查。我们的分析揭示了两个令人担忧的发现。
tldr: 本研究首次实证揭示，在众包空中灾害评估中，不同影像来源（无人机、有人机、卫星）下标注者和审查者的表现存在显著差异，且单审查者阶段可能无法有效识别错误，这对多源遥感数据集的构建质量提出了挑战。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first empirical evidence that annotator and reviewer performance varies significantly across imagery sources (drone, crewed aviation, satellite) in crowd-sourced aerial damage assessment, and the single-reviewer stage may fail to effectively catch errors, challenging the quality of multi-source remote sensing dataset construction.
